newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Sabca wins one bln Bfr Belgian contracts.
newsitem.headline: Sabca wins one bln Bfr Belgian contracts.

text.p: The Belgian government said in a statement after its weekly cabinet meeting on Friday it was in talks or had awarded contracts to Belgian defence firm Sabca SA worth around one billion Belgian francs.
The government said the air force would purchase from Sabca six reconnaissance cameras for its F-16 fighters for a total value of around 120 million francs.
In addition, the defence ministry would start talks with Sabca about modernisation work on other F-16 aircraft for a value of around 842 million francs.
